messages:
devon: quick question — running into a mismatch between the model's function/tool JSON and the TS SDK types when we try to coerce structured outputs. The model sometimes returns extra keys and sometimes omits nullable fields, and our current coercion throws. reproducer: call model with tool `extract_customer` -> model replies with {
  "id": 123,
  "name": "ACME",
  "meta": { "source": "email" },
  "unexpected_flag": true
}
My TS type is: `type Customer = { id: number; name: string; meta?: { source?: string } }` — the SDK does a strict check and rejects because of `unexpected_flag`. Any recommended pattern? should we relax SDK or add a shim?
messages_continued: maria: yeah we ran into this last month with webhook parsing. two quick options: 1) canonicalize with a schema validator (zod/ajv) that strips unknown keys, or 2) make the SDK coercion opt-in with `allowExtraKeys: true` and return a `raw` field. i prefer 1 for safety. also: add a versioned schema so downstream can opt-in to new keys.
messages_more: sam: there's an open PR that introduces `schemaAdapters` for func/tool outputs — it lets you supply a JSON schema + a transformer. i linked it in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/432. it has an `stripUnknown: boolean` option. might solve this without changing core typings.
messages_streaming_issue: devon: thanks — one extra wrinkle: these func outputs come over streaming responses. sometimes the last chunk contains the extra key and the parser tries to coerce mid-stream and fails. any streaming-safe patterns?
messages_streaming_replies: alex: for streaming structured outputs we do a small buffer + incremental json assembly approach. basically accumulate text until you can `JSON.parse` a complete object, then run schema through validator. pseudo:
messages_streaming_followup: alex: caveat: if model emits multiple JSON objects in one stream you need to split (newline-delimited or double-newline). we added `sdk-tools/streamingJson()` helper in one repo — can port here.
messages_taylor: taylor: i can prototype a `stripUnknown` option on the TS SDK plus a streaming-safe helper that buffers and uses a user-provided schema. will open a draft PR and tag y'all for review. pinging @maria @sam for API design decisions. :thumbsup:
messages_ci: ci-bot: Heads up — current master build failing on `func-output-tests` (parsing edgecases). logs: https://ci.redwood/1234 — not related to this thread but worth syncing if we change coercion defaults.
messages_action: devon: awesome — if taylor can spin up a draft PR with: 1) `allowExtraKeys: 'strip'|'preserve'` option 2) streaming helper example 3) tests for multi-object streams — i'll try to validate against the production reproducer. assigning to taylor. thanks!
messages_close: maria: also capture a migration note — changing default behavior could break apps relying on thrown errors. prefer opt-in. :eyes:
messages_final: taylor: noted. will make it opt-in and add a migration doc in the PR. draft in ~2h and i'll ping the thread.
